reason: An AI-assisted tabletop RPG and GM workflow plugin that adds dice and check tools, lore and character-card context, session state tracking, commands, and DiceFrame save interoperability.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH AI 跑团会话提供真实掷骰、检定判定、世界书与角色卡注入、桌台状态管理，以及 DiceFrame 存档互通。
summaries.en: Adds real dice rolls, check resolution, lore and character-card context, tabletop session state, commands, and DiceFrame save interoperability to DSH roleplaying sessions.

capabilities: Performs dice rolls and check resolution through plugin tools and slash commands
Injects world books and character cards into agent prompts
Maintains isolated tabletop session state including scenes, NPCs, and initiative
Reads and writes DiceFrame-compatible save files and archives
